headline: Consumer stocks dominate the market with EMC plunging 50% and PLE surging 28.57% in a single day.
market_take: The Consumer sector showed the widest swings, driven by EMC's 50% intraday drop and PLE's 28.57% rally with a 14.29% opening gap. Property stocks posted several strong gains, notably PF up 25% and RML up 25%, while BLAND slipped 7.14% after an 8.45% intraday fall. Food stocks posted modest upside across the board, and unusual trading activity was concentrated in Food, Consumer, Property and AgrI tickers.

sector_notes.note: EMC fell 50% intraday, while PLE jumped 28.57% with a 14.29% opening gap and a 12.5% intraday rise; APCS also showed a 5.34% opening gap.
PF surged 25% intraday and reported a director change; RML and CGD each rose 25% and 10% respectively, whereas BLAND dropped 7.14% after an 8.45% intraday fall and JCK opened with an 8.33% gap.
MADAME gained 6.45% intraday, KSL rose 6.37% on strong volume, and F&D added 5.95%; XBIO and AQUA filed significant disclosures.
GEL opened down 25% and TPIPL recorded a volume spike; filings disclosed a strategic investment to enter smart‑toilet manufacturing.
TEGH, UVAN and SMO each experienced volume spikes above 3.5σ, while TL reported progress on an acquisition.
SSPF fell 8.28% and both TIF1 and TTLPF posted notable volume spikes.

watchlist.reason: Intraday plunge of 50% in Consumer sector.
28.57% rise with 14.29% opening gap and 12.5% intraday move.
25% intraday gain in Property sector; director change filing.
25% opening gap down in CONMAT; linked to strategic investment filing.
Filed strategic investment to enter smart‑toilet market.

risk_flags: EMC's 50% drop signals heightened downside risk in Consumer stocks.
BLAND's sudden -8.45% intraday move warrants caution.
GEL's 25% opening gap down may indicate underlying weakness.
PF's director change could affect governance perception.
High sigma volume spikes in AgrI tickers suggest speculative pressure.
